title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani breaks down after rejecting Anbu's closeness and refuses to believe in him again. Devastated by her decision, Anbu gives up hope of rebuilding their relationship.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: After the doctor saves Ilamathi, she learns her food is poisoned. Recalling that she has sent the same batter to the Ashram, she rushes there with Paraman and saves the children.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Karna troubles Abinaya by demanding that she vacate her house, citing changed loan terms. Vetri challenges Karna, vowing to clear her entire debt within two days.
